text: Multidisciplinary tumor board for 57M with stage IV pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma with liver and peritoneal metastases. ATTENDEES: Medical oncology, surgical oncology, radiation oncology, radiology, pathology, genetics, palliative care. PRESENTATION: Locally advanced unresectable pancreatic cancer with extensive metastatic disease. BRCA2 germline mutation carrier. Performance status ECOG 1-2, improving after biliary stent. CA 19-9: 1250. DISCUSSION: Patient not surgical candidate due to vascular involvement and metastatic disease. BRCA2 mutation makes patient eligible for platinum-based therapy followed by PARP inhibitor maintenance. Prognosis remains poor but BRCA mutation offers therapeutic target. RECOMMENDATIONS: (1) Initiate FOLFIRINOX chemotherapy (pending performance status improvement to ECOG 1). (2) If good response, consider switching to PARP inhibitor maintenance therapy. (3) Early palliative care involvement. (4) Genetic counseling for family members. (5) Monitor CA 19-9 and imaging every 8 weeks. Patient and family counseled regarding poor prognosis but potential benefit from targeted therapy. Patient opts to proceed with aggressive treatment.
